pr_title: roachtest: fail the latency verifier immediately if latency is too high
pr_body:
Previously, the latency verifier used by c2c and cdc roachtests would not fail immediately if latency was too high. This patch fails the latency verifier immediately, as the roachtest is going to eventually fail anyway.

In addition, immediately after a latency verifier failure, this patch captures c2c debug zips to better understand the cause of the increased latency.

Fixes #117182

Release note: none
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/117519)

comments: From the logs, it looks to me like while the lag did balloon, it did eventually recover back to <1min lag. I wonder if we had a stuck rangefeed somewhere.
Marking as a non-release blocking P3 because this is a preview feature and the cluster did recover. But, we should investigate this at some point.

review_comments: Note to self/other reviewers: maxSeenSteadyLatency is only set once we've already already established a latency below the targetSteadyLatency.
